from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_home_page():
    response = client.get('/')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert 'Come in. Sit down. Tell us about your human.' in response.text

def test_app_run_reload():
    # Check that uvicorn.run is called with reload=True only under __main__
    import inspect
    import app
    # Check the if __name__ == "__main__" block exists
    source = inspect.getsource(app)
    assert 'reload=True' in source
    assert 'if __name__ == "__main__"' in source
